stem: Which of the following best describes a work breakdown structure (WBS)?
options: A hierarchy of project deliverables down to work packages
A timeline showing activity durations and key milestones
A register of identified risks and their response plans
An organization chart of the project team and roles
explanation: WBS（工作分解结构）是以可交付成果为导向的层级分解，从项目目标一直拆到工作包。B 项描述的是进度网络图或甘特图，C 项是风险登记册，D 项是项目组织结构图，均非 WBS 的定义。

stem: The critical path in a project network diagram is the path that _____.
options: contains the most activities and the highest cost
has the longest duration and determines the project finish
has the shortest duration and the most total float
includes all activities that can be done in parallel
explanation: 关键路径是网络图中总持续时间最长的路径，其长度决定项目总工期，路径上活动的总时差通常为零。A 项只看活动数量，C 项把关键路径与最短路径混淆，D 项并行执行不是关键路径的特征。

stem: A stakeholder is best defined as a person or group that _____.
options: funds the project and signs the project charter
leads the project team on a day-to-day basis
performs the technical work of the project
is affected by or can affect the project outcome
explanation: 干系人（stakeholder）是指能影响项目、被项目影响，或自认为会被项目影响的个人或群体。A 项只说了发起人，B 项是项目经理，C 项是团队成员，三者都只是干系人的一部分，范围过窄。

stem: Uncontrolled scope expansion without adjusting time and cost is called _____.
options: gold plating by the project team
scope verification by the customer
scope creep, harming overall control
progressive elaboration of the plan
explanation: 范围蔓延（scope creep）指未经变更控制就扩大项目范围，不相应调整时间与成本，导致整体失控。A 项镀金是团队主动多做功能，B 项范围确认是客户验收成果，D 项渐进明细是正当的规划方式。

stem: The group that reviews and approves change requests is called _____.
options: change control board (CCB)
project management office (PMO)
quality assurance department
project sponsor and end users
explanation: 变更控制委员会（CCB）是正式评审、批准或否决变更请求的机构。B 项 PMO 是项目管理办公室，提供组织级支持；C 项质量保证部门管质量体系；D 项发起人和用户是干系人，都不是变更审批的正式主体。

stem: In earned value management, the cost performance index (CPI) equals _____.
options: earned value divided by planned value
earned value divided by actual cost
actual cost divided by planned value
planned value divided by actual cost
explanation: 成本绩效指数 CPI = 挣值 EV ÷ 实际成本 AC，大于 1 表示成本节约。A 项 EV/PV 是进度绩效指数 SPI；C 项 AC/PV 与 D 项 PV/AC 均非标准公式，CPI 与 SPI 的分子都是挣值 EV。

stem: Which document lists identified project risks and their characteristics?
options: the work breakdown structure (WBS)
the project scope statement document
the risk register of the project
the issue log and lessons learned
explanation: 风险登记册（risk register）记录已识别风险的清单及描述、类别、概率、影响和应对措施。A 项 WBS 分解的是工作范围，B 项范围说明书描述项目边界，D 项问题日志记录已发生的问题，都不负责登记风险。

stem: Sending an RFP to vendors and selecting a supplier belongs to _____.
options: project procurement management
project quality management
project resource management
project communications management
explanation: 向供应商发出建议邀请书（RFP）并选择供应商，属于项目采购管理。B 项质量管理关注产品与过程质量，C 项资源管理主要管团队与实物资源，D 项沟通管理管信息传递，都不涉及从外部获取商品与服务。

stem: A project milestone typically has which of the following characteristics?
options: It requires a large amount of resources to complete
It has a long duration and measurable output
It is an optional task that can be skipped easily
It marks a key event and has zero duration
explanation: 里程碑（milestone）是项目中的重要时间点或事件，持续时间为 0，本身不消耗资源，用于标记阶段性成果。A、B 两项把它当成了普通任务；C 项说成可跳过的可选任务，与里程碑的标志性作用相悖。

stem: A project has 6 team members. How many communication channels exist?
options: 12 channels
15 channels
21 channels
30 channels
explanation: 沟通渠道数 = n(n−1)/2，其中 n = 6，代入得 6 × 5 ÷ 2 = 15 条。A 项 12 是 6 × 2 的误算；C 项 21 是 7 人时的渠道数；D 项 30 是 n(n−1) 未除以 2 的结果。

stem: TCP/IP is best described as a suite of _____.
options: hardware devices used for network routing
programming languages used for web apps
protocols for data communication on networks
database tools used for data storage
explanation: TCP/IP 是互联网基础的协议族，定义了数据如何在网络中封装、寻址和传输。A 项指的是路由器等硬件设备，B 项是编程语言，D 项是数据库工具，都不是协议族的定义。

stem: Which of the following best describes cloud computing?
options: Building private data centers for one company
Storing all data on local hard drives only
Using desktop software without any network
Accessing computing resources on demand via network
explanation: 云计算是通过网络按需获取计算资源（服务器、存储、应用等），通常按使用量计费。A 项自建机房属于传统 IT 架构，B 项本地存储是离线模式，C 项无网络使用桌面软件更不属于云计算。

stem: Encryption is used in information security mainly to ensure _____.
options: that data is always available to every user
confidentiality by making data unreadable without a key
that hardware devices run faster than before
that data cannot be compressed or archived
explanation: 加密通过算法把明文变成密文，只有持有密钥者才能还原，主要保障机密性。A 项说的是可用性，C 项性能与加密无关，D 项压缩归档也不属于加密目的；加密有时反而会增加处理开销。

stem: In a relational database, data is organized into _____.
options: tables made up of rows and columns
files stored in a folder tree
documents in a word processor
images and audio files in a gallery
explanation: 关系数据库把数据组织成表（table），表由行（记录）和列（字段）构成，表之间通过键建立关联。B 项是文件系统的组织方式，C、D 两项是办公软件和媒体文件的存储形式，与关系模型无关。

stem: A firewall in a network primarily functions to _____.
options: speed up data transmission between two hosts
store backups of important business data
filter network traffic based on security rules
assign IP addresses to computers automatically
explanation: 防火墙按安全策略过滤网络流量，允许或阻止特定通信，是网络安全的边界设备。A 项加速传输是广域网优化，B 项存备份是存储系统，D 项自动分配 IP 是 DHCP 服务器的功能。

stem: An API is best described as _____.
options: a type of computer virus or malware
a hardware cable for connecting devices
a coding style guide for developers
an interface for software components to interact
explanation: API（应用程序编程接口）定义了软件组件之间如何调用和交换数据，是系统集成的桥梁。A 项是病毒或恶意软件，B 项是连接设备的硬件线缆，C 项是编码规范，都不是接口的定义。

stem: HTTPS differs from HTTP mainly in that HTTPS _____.
options: encrypts data in transit using SSL or TLS
transmits data at a much higher speed
does not need a web server to work
only works on local area networks
explanation: HTTPS 在 HTTP 基础上加入 SSL/TLS 加密，保证传输过程的机密性和完整性。B 项速度与是否加密无关，C 项仍需要 Web 服务器，D 项 HTTPS 同样用于互联网，并不限于局域网。

stem: The SQL command used to retrieve data from a database is _____.
options: INSERT, which adds new records to a table
UPDATE, which modifies existing records
SELECT, which queries and returns data
DELETE, which removes records from a table
explanation: SELECT 语句用于从数据库中查询并返回数据，是 SQL 的检索命令。A 项 INSERT 用于插入新记录，B 项 UPDATE 用于修改记录，D 项 DELETE 用于删除记录，三者都不负责查询返回。

stem: The process of verifying who a user is before granting access is called _____.
options: authorization, which checks what one can do
authentication, which verifies one's identity
accounting, which records user activity
encryption, which protects data content
explanation: 认证（authentication）是验证用户身份的过程，回答你是谁。A 项授权（authorization）是验证通过后决定你能做什么；C 项审计是 AAA 模型中的记录环节；D 项加密保护数据内容，与身份验证无关。

stem: Virtualization technology allows a single physical server to _____.
options: run only one operating system at a time
eliminate the need for any storage device
connect to the network without any cables
host multiple virtual machines simultaneously
explanation: 虚拟化把一台物理服务器划分为多台虚拟机，各自运行独立的操作系统，提高资源利用率。A 项说只能跑一个系统恰与虚拟化相反；B 项存储设备、C 项网络连接都不是虚拟化的直接作用。

stem: If CPI is 0.8 and SPI is 1.1, which statement is correct?
options: The project is over budget but ahead of schedule
The project is under budget and ahead of schedule
The project is over budget and behind schedule
The project is under budget but behind schedule
explanation: CPI = EV/AC = 0.8 < 1，说明成本超支；SPI = EV/PV = 1.1 > 1，说明进度超前。B 项把 CPI < 1 误读为节约；C、D 两项对 SPI > 1 的判断都错了，SPI 大于 1 表示提前而非落后。

stem: Delivering extra features that the customer did not request is called _____.
options: scope validation and quality control
gold plating and should be avoided
progressive elaboration of scope
requirements traceability management
explanation: 镀金（gold plating）是主动做客户未要求的额外功能，虽出于好意却可能增加成本、引入缺陷，应当避免。A 项范围确认是客户验收成果，C 项渐进明细是正当的规划方式，D 项需求跟踪也不含多做功能。

stem: In a RACI matrix, the letter R stands for _____.
options: Review, the person who checks the work
Report, the person who documents results
Responsible, the one who does the work
Resource, the one who provides funding
explanation: RACI 中 R 是 Responsible（执行者），即实际完成工作的人。A 项 Reviewer 不是 RACI 的标准字母；B 项 Report 也不在 RACI 中；D 项 Resource 混淆了资源与角色。其余字母是 A（批准）、C（咨询）、I（知会）。

stem: The contingency reserve in project cost management is budget _____.
options: already spent on completed project work
for unknown-unknown risks outside the baseline
added as profit margin to the total budget
for identified risks and included in the baseline
explanation: 应急储备（contingency reserve）针对已识别风险预留，包含在成本基准内，由项目经理在风险发生时使用。B 项是管理储备的定义，应对未知风险且不在基准内；A 项是已发生成本；C 项利润与储备无关。

stem: Acceptance criteria are defined to _____.
options: estimate the cost of project deliverables
define when deliverables can be accepted
identify all project risks and threats
organize the project team structure
explanation: 验收标准（acceptance criteria）定义了可交付成果被客户或发起人接受所必须满足的条件。A 项是估算成本，C 项是识别风险，D 项是设计组织结构，都不属于验收标准的用途。

stem: Lessons learned documents are most useful for _____.
options: future projects and the rest of the current project
calculating team members' annual bonuses
justifying budget increases to the sponsor
replacing formal project status reports
explanation: 经验教训（lessons learned）文档记录项目中的成功经验与失败教训，可供当前项目后半段和未来项目借鉴。B 项奖金核算、C 项预算申请、D 项状态汇报都不是经验教训的主要用途。

stem: A statement of work (SOW) typically includes all of the following EXCEPT _____.
options: a description of the work to be performed
the period of performance and deliverables
the location where the work will be done
the project team's individual salary details
explanation: 工作说明书（SOW）描述采购工作范围、可交付成果、执行地点和履约期限等内容。D 项团队个人薪资明细属于保密的人力资源信息，不会写进面向供应商的 SOW。

stem: Which risk analysis technique uses a computer model with random sampling?
options: Delphi technique with expert judgment
SWOT analysis of the project context
Monte Carlo simulation of project outcomes
root cause analysis using a fishbone diagram
explanation: 蒙特卡洛模拟通过大量随机抽样模拟项目结果的概率分布，属于定量风险分析。A 项德尔菲法是专家匿名评估，B 项 SWOT 分析优势劣势，D 项鱼骨图做根因分析，都不使用随机抽样模型。

stem: The process of comparing actual results with the plan is called _____.
options: monitoring and controlling project work
developing the project management plan
collecting requirements from stakeholders
closing the project or a project phase
explanation: 监控项目工作就是将实际绩效与计划基准对比，发现偏差并推动纠正或预防措施。B 项是编制计划，C 项是收集需求，D 项是项目收尾，都不涉及实际结果与基准的比较分析。

stem: Configuration management is primarily concerned with _____.
options: motivating team members to improve performance
estimating project costs accurately
managing formal change requests to the project
tracking versions and integrity of product items
explanation: 配置管理关注产品配置项的识别、版本控制和完整性，确保产品与文档始终一致。C 项说的是整体变更控制，管理的是项目层面的变更请求，是强干扰项；A 项是团队激励，B 项是成本估算。

stem: What does DNS do in a computer network?
options: Encrypts data packets during transmission
Translates domain names to IP addresses
Stores files for later retrieval by users
Provides power to network hardware devices
explanation: DNS（域名系统）把便于记忆的域名解析为 IP 地址，相当于互联网的地址簿。A 项是加密协议的功能，C 项是文件服务器，D 项供电与 DNS 无关。

stem: A load balancer distributes incoming requests mainly to _____.
options: reduce the need for any network security
store data on multiple backup servers
share traffic across several backend servers
compress data before sending it to users
explanation: 负载均衡器把请求分发到多台后端服务器，避免单点过载，提高吞吐量和可用性。A 项安全不是它的直接目的，B 项是备份系统，D 项数据压缩是编码优化，都不是负载均衡的核心功能。

stem: In a relational database, a primary key must be _____.
options: unique for each record and never null
duplicated across multiple tables
a text field of at least 255 characters
automatically generated by the user
explanation: 主键用于唯一标识表中每条记录，必须满足唯一性且不能为空。B 项可以重复的是普通字段；C 项长度并非主键的规定；D 项主键可以系统生成也可以业务指定，核心约束是唯一且非空。

stem: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for end-to-end delivery?
options: the physical layer for bit transmission
the data link layer for local framing
the application layer for user services
the transport layer for reliable delivery
explanation: OSI 模型的传输层负责端到端的数据传输与可靠性控制，典型协议是 TCP。A 物理层传输比特流，B 数据链路层负责局域网帧传递，C 应用层直接面向用户服务，都不承担端到端交付职责。

stem: RPO in disaster recovery planning refers to the maximum acceptable _____.
options: time to restore services after an outage
data loss measured backward from a disaster
cost of building a backup data center
number of servers that can fail at once
explanation: RPO（恢复点目标）是灾难发生时可接受的最大数据丢失量，用时间衡量，看数据能回退多久。A 项是 RTO（恢复时间目标），C 项是成本估算，D 项故障数量与 RPO 无关。

stem: A compiler differs from an interpreter in that a compiler _____.
options: executes code directly without any translation
is used only for writing web pages
translates the whole program before execution
cannot detect syntax errors in the source
explanation: 编译器把整个源程序翻译成目标代码后再执行，解释器则边翻译边执行。A 项说的是直接执行，两者都需要翻译；B 项网页不是编译器的专属领域；D 项编译器恰恰擅长在编译阶段发现语法错误。

stem: Containers such as Docker differ from virtual machines mainly because _____.
options: containers cannot be moved between hosts
containers each need a full guest OS
containers are slower than virtual machines
containers share the host OS kernel and are lighter
explanation: 容器直接共享宿主机操作系统内核，只打包应用和依赖，比虚拟机更轻量、启动更快。A 项容器可跨主机迁移；B 项需要完整客户机操作系统的是虚拟机；C 项容器启动通常更快而非更慢。

stem: A phishing attack typically tricks users into _____.
options: revealing passwords or sensitive information
physically damaging hardware components
flooding the network with huge traffic
encrypting files without keeping any key
explanation: 网络钓鱼（phishing）通过伪装邮件或网站诱骗用户主动交出密码、账号等敏感信息。B 项是物理破坏，C 项是拒绝服务攻击，D 项是勒索软件的行为，都不是钓鱼的典型手段。

stem: Middleware is software that primarily _____.
options: replaces the operating system kernel
connects applications and enables integration
designs user interface graphics and colors
compiles source code into machine language
explanation: 中间件（middleware）位于操作系统与应用之间，提供通信、数据交换等服务，帮助异构系统集成。A 项内核是操作系统的核心组件；C 项界面设计属于 UI 工作；D 项编译是编译器的功能。

stem: A cryptographic hash function is designed to be _____.
options: reversible with any public key
slow on large input data sets
one-way and collision-resistant
identical for different inputs
explanation: 哈希函数是单向的：由摘要无法反推原文，且不同输入应极难产生相同摘要（抗碰撞性）。A 项可逆是加密解密的特征；B 项好的哈希反而要求高效；D 项不同输入相同输出正是碰撞，不安全。
